record.question: A male patient enquires about the effectiveness of vasectomy compared to female tubectomy. Which statement is MOST accurate?
options: Tubectomy is more effective than vasectomy
Vasectomy is safer, simpler, and equally effective
record.explanation: Answer B: Vasectomy is safer, simpler, and equally effective. Vasectomy is generally simpler than female tubal surgery and has comparable high effectiveness after success is confirmed. It is not immediately effective: alternative contraception is needed until post-vasectomy semen testing confirms success. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/contraception/hcp/usspr/vasectomy.html; https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/contraception/vasectomy-male-sterilisation/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
